newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends STA Group.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends STA Group.

text.p: Thailand's stock exchange said on Wednesday that it had suspended trading in shares of the troubled STA Group pending clarification from the firm of its plans to restructure.
The suspension followed newspaper reports that STA Group was negotiating with its creditor bank, the Krung Thai Bank to allow a listed Malaysian firm, Pan Pacific Asia Berhad, to take it over.
The stock exchange said it had not received any information from the company, a particle board maker, about any such plan and awaited a company response.

The reports quoted company president Kamol Poolsawat as saying production by the company had nearly ground to a halt. They added that the STA Group faced 11 billion baht in debts to several creditors. The company recently delayed repayment on its 1.1 billion baht in debentures issued to the public.
